Hi Sofia — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and next steps so we're aligned: 

- FinBank needs EU-only data residency for customer PII and must ensure processing stays in EU for regulated product lines.
- You're evaluating three deployment modes: Hosted API (fastest launch), Dedicated (reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput), Private (VPC/on-prem for the highest isolation and regulatory controls).
- Key asks from your legal/security team: EU data-at-rest and in-transit guarantees, KMS/HSM support, SOC 2 + DPA language, and explicit cross-region routing policies (we heard you want to avoid accidental egress to non-EU regions).

Attachments: Redwood-Deployment-Modes.pdf (high-level), SLA-Overview-2027.pdf, DPA-Summary-Redwood.docx.

Ask: Can you confirm whether FinBank will accept a Hosted API if we guarantee all processing and storage in EU regions (we can provide region pinning + contractual guarantees), or does procurement/legal require Private VPC/on-prem for the regulated product? Also: any target timeline for pilot (Q3/Q4)?

Proposed next step: 30-min technical follow-up next week with your security lead + our infra manager (Marissa) to walk region availability, KMS integration, and deployment checklist. I copied Marissa to schedule.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Hi Aditya — thanks for the summary, that matches our notes. A few clarifications from legal/security: 

- For our EU retail product (highly regulated), data must be stored and processed in the EU and we need contractual guarantees (DPA + audit rights).
- For B2B/APAC customers we support later, those can be processed in APAC regions but only after we complete a separate review. For now the pilot must be EU-only.
- Cross-region routing: our networking team forbids any automatic cross-region failover that would egress data outside EU without an explicit configuration and sign-off. So we need confirmation that Hosted API can be constrained to EU physical regions (no fallback to US/APAC).
- KMS: we prefer customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) in a KMS instance; HSM is necessary for certain data flows.

Pilot timeline: target pilot start mid-August (approx). Procurement will need vendor security paperwork and a draft SLA to start procurement review.

Can Marissa or someone on infra confirm region pinning and BYOK capabilities?

Regards,
Sofia Müller
Head of Platform Security | FinBank AG
sofia.muller@finbank.de

Hi Sofia / Aditya — thanks for the clear summary. Short answers below so procurement/security have what they need: 

1) Hosted API region pinning: Yes — we can restrict a customer's Hosted API traffic and storage to EU physical regions (we currently offer eu-central-1 and eu-west-1). We also provide contractual language to guarantee processing & storage in specified regions and can put region pinning in the DPA/SLA. Fallbacks to other regions are opt-in only and would require explicit configuration and documented approval.

2) KMS / BYOK / HSM: We support customer-managed keys for both Dedicated and Private deployments. For Hosted API we offer BYOK via KMS integration with dedicated customer key material; HSM-backed keys are available for Private VPC and on-prem variants. We can include KMS integration details in the security package.

3) Timeline: 
- Dedicated (reserved capacity) in EU: typical onboarding 2–4 weeks after contract signature (we provision GPU pools and apply tenancy/networking).
- Private VPC (customer-managed control plane or on-prem): 6–8 weeks for standard VPC deployment. On-prem timelines vary by customer infra procurement and change windows.

4) Pilot feasibility for mid-August: If you choose Hosted EU-only (region pinned), that's the fastest route — we can reuse existing hosted infra and start a pilot in ~2–3 weeks for a limited scope. Dedicated is also feasible for mid-August if procurement can sign a short-term commit quickly; Private VPC will likely miss mid-August unless the customer can accelerate network approvals.

Next step: I'd propose a 30-min tech call next week between FinBank security/networking and our infra lead (Lauren) to walk region pinning, KMS flow, and the pilot scoping. Aditya — feel free to propose two slots and I'll confirm.

Attachments: SLA-Overview-2027.pdf (high level SLAs), DPA-Summary-Redwood.docx (we can expand as needed).
